notes: Defect: promo code discount amount is incorrect in Mozio email confirmation for return-trip tickets. The discount is likely applied in full to the outbound dispatch and either missing or duplicated on the return dispatch, rather than being correctly distributed across both trip segments. The mapping layer that builds the Mozio dispatch payload (including report.price.discount) for return trips is the fix site.

notes: Openspec provided empty acceptance criteria with only a descriptive note about the defect. I built the full AC set from scratch based on the defect description and the listed technical files. Key design decisions: (1) AC-1 establishes the invariant that total discount is preserved across segments; (2) AC-2 and AC-3 ensure the discount is split rather than fully applied to one segment or missing from the other — the core bug; (3) AC-4 is a regression guard ensuring one-way trips are unaffected; (4) AC-5 covers rounding/penny-drift edge cases which are common when splitting monetary values; (5) AC-6 covers the zero-discount edge case; (6) AC-7 ties the dispatch payload fix back to the user-visible email confirmation; (7) AC-8 guards against over-discounting a single segment beyond its price.
